sentences.en: Most would acknowledge that he was a sparkling young man.
sentences.zh: 大多数人都会承认他是一个光彩照人的年轻人。

sentences.en: The dew on the trees sparkles in the morning sun.
sentences.zh: 树上的露珠在早晨阳光下闪闪发光。

sentences.en: She looks at her arm and sees a sparkling bracelet.
sentences.zh: 她看着自己的手臂，看到一只闪耀的手链。
